censusName: Canopy by Hilton Cancun La Isla
directoryName: Canopy by Hilton Cancun La Isla
headline: A vibrant stay in Cancun
primaryDescription: Embrace the energy of Cancun with a stay next to La Isla Mall. Our thoughtfully curated hotel offers a vibrant stay just steps from the area's best nightlife, shopping, beach clubs, and more. Relax at our on-site spa and enjoy our rooftop lounge for stunning views of the lagoon, poolside drinks, and live music.

censusName: Canopy by Hilton Sao Paulo Jardins
directoryName: Canopy by Hilton Sao Paulo Jardins
headline: A stylish stay in the Jardins district
primaryDescription: Embrace the vibrant energy of São Paulo at our hotel located in the Jardins district. We're within a 20 minute walk of Ibirapuera Park, Paulista Avenue, Oscar Freire Street shops, and museums. We offer complimentary Canopy Bikes and WiFi. Savor authentic Brazilian fare at our all-day restaurant, serving a delicious Saturday feijoada buffet.

headline: A beachfront resort set on the Riviera Nayarit
primaryDescription: Our stylish retreat rests along the Riviera Nayarit. Set amid palm trees, our hotel boasts access to an exclusive beach, three outdoor pools, and accommodations with balconies overlooking the Pacific Ocean. We have a spa, Mexican temazcal, a 24-hour fitness center, tennis and basketball courts, and access to land and water activities.

headline: A sanctuary of wonder on the coast of Riviera Maya
primaryDescription: Among the mangroves of the magical Riviera Maya, ancient roots and a future-focused commitment to sustainability blend in a mesmerizing dance. Seek serenity in our spa, and uncover your sense of wonder in Tulum’s masterpieces - from the architectural savvy in nearby ruins, to the cool clarity in underground cenotes.

censusName: Anselmo Buenos Aires Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Anselmo Buenos Aires, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A hidden modern jewel at Plaza Dorrego
primaryDescription: Our hotel features a sleek, modern interior design cleverly hidden inside an exterior reflecting San Telmo's historic architecture and cobblestone streets. Plaza Dorrego is just beyond our doorstep, and we're a five-minute walk from many bars and eateries. The Museum of Modern Art is two blocks away.

censusName: Botanika Osa Peninsula Resort Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Botanika Osa Peninsula Costa Rica Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: An explorer’s paradise along Golfo Dulce
primaryDescription: Find us where Costa Rica's unspoiled rainforest meets the ocean. Our resort features studio and multi-room suites for a comfortable escape. Enjoy hiking in Corcovado National Park, ziplining, sport fishing, and eco-adventures like our sloth and chocolate farm tours. We offer pools, a wellness spa, and access to Cahui Beach Club at Preciosa Beach.

censusName: Gran Hotel Costa Rica Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Gran Hotel Costa Rica, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Historic charm in the heart of San Jose
primaryDescription: Our 1930’s building, a historical-architectural monument of Costa Rica, features contemporary urban interiors. We’re located on the Avenida Central pedestrian boulevard, steps from the National Theatre, Gold Museum, cafés, and shops. We have a fitness center and piano bar. Our staff is on-hand with recommendations to help you live like a local.

censusName: Curio Collection by Hilton Harbor Club St Lucia
directoryName: Harbor Club St. Lucia, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Tropical beauty and maritime charm in St. Lucia
primaryDescription: Experience a taste of the island lifestyle at Harbor Club St. Lucia, Curio Collection by Hilton. Set in the Gros Islet quarter on the northwest coast, our Caribbean resort provides a laid-back getaway near some of the island’s top beaches, attractions, and nightlife.

censusName: Hotel Santiago Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Hotel Santiago, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Mountain views next to Agora Mall
primaryDescription: Find us in downtown Santiago, adjacent to Agora Mall. The Monument to the Heroes of the Restoration and the Santiago Apostol Cathedral are each within a 10-minute drive. We offer a 24-hour fitness center, event space, and an outdoor pool with hammocks. Enjoy our cigar lounge, pool bar, and restaurant.

censusName: Hualta Hotel Mendoza Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Hualta Hotel Mendoza, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Central location near wineries and shops
primaryDescription: We’re a block from San Martin Ave., surrounded by shops and restaurants. Parque General San Martin and Mendoza Plaza Shopping are both less than a 15-minute drive. Several wineries are within 30 minutes of us, including Bodega Tierras Altas. Plumerillo International Airport MDZ is 10 km away. Enjoy our restaurant and meeting space.

censusName: Indura Beach & Golf Resort Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Indura Beach & Golf Resort Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A tropical stay on the Caribbean coast
primaryDescription: Our Honduran villas are surrounded by tropical jungle and overlook the Caribbean Sea. Tela, Lancetilla Botanical Garden, and Punta Sal are within 14 kilometers. The resort features a spa, fitness center, tennis court, three swimming pools, and an 18-hole golf course. Enjoy dining at our restaurants, live music at Bahari Bar Lounge, and room service.

censusName: Koi Resort Saint Kitts Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Koi Resort Saint Kitts, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A Half Moon Bay stay beside beaches and golf
primaryDescription: Find us on the Half Moon Bay, a five-minute drive to Royal St. Kitts Golf Club. We’re less than 10 minutes from the St. Kitts Scenic Railway. Visit Brimstone Hill Fortress National Park a half-hour away. Our hotel features an outdoor pool, spa, and on-site restaurant. Our concierge is on hand to arrange tours and more.

censusName: Mahogany Bay Resort & Beach Club, Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Mahogany Bay Resort & Beach Club, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Private beachside service near San Pedro
primaryDescription: Our resort on Ambergris Caye offers exclusive access to Belize’s only private Beach Club. A 15-minute free boat ride will take you to our white sand beach with cabana beds, overwater hammocks, and beach service from the bar and grill. Discover our restaurants, pool, village, and marina. Diving and adventure tours can be arranged by our tour operator.

censusName: The Rif at Mangrove Beach Corendon Curacao All-Inclusive Curio by Hilton
directoryName: Mangrove Beach Corendon Curacao All-Inclusive Resort, Curio by Hilton
headline: Resort life amid the mangroves
primaryDescription: There are activities for everyone at our all-inclusive beachfront resort, from on-site water sports to daily adventure tours and activities. Enjoy our four pools, aquapark with water slides, children's playground, art workshop, cigar lounge and dive center. We also offer four themed restaurants along with our Breeze buffet restaurant, our 24/7 Pera Lobby Bar & Patisserie and other bars and food establishments. All in all,  a true Caribbean escape.

censusName: MS Milenium Monterrey Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: MS Milenium Monterrey, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A cosmopolitan San Pedro stay
primaryDescription: Find us in Zona Valle, across from Fashion Drive mall and a 15-minute walk to Showcenter. Every room offers Sierra Madre views, and suites have kitchenettes and lounge access. Enjoy all-day dining, a drink in our terrace garden, or bar bites in the golf simulator. A fitness center, tennis court, and indoor pool await, as well as over 1,400 sq. m. of event space.

directoryName: Nacar Hotel Cartagena, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A historic stay in Ciudad Amurallada
primaryDescription: Find us in the historic center of Cartagena. Set in a restored historic landmark, our hotel features two towers, a colonial ambiance, and modern elegance. The Walled City and Plaza Santo Domingo are within a kilometer, and we’re six km from Rafael Núñez International Airport. Enjoy our fitness center and city views from our pool and terrace bar.

censusName: Mahogany Bay Resort & Beach Club, Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Numo Ierapetra Beach Resort Crete, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Relaxing adults-only beachfront escape
primaryDescription: Our adults-only seaside resort showcases Ierapetra, a less-traveled part of southern Crete, through a modern lens. We offer a barefoot luxury resort with earthy design touches, surrounded by evergreen gardens and mountains. Enjoy our open-air cinema, individual swimming pools, and cozy terraces to complete your escape.

censusName: Palacio Provincial San Juan Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Palacio Provincial San Juan, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A taste of history in Old San Juan
primaryDescription: In Old San Juan, our adult-only hotel immerses you in the oldest city in US Territory. From our building and courtyard to nearby shops, we’re surrounded by San Juan’s architecture. We're next to the Cathedral of San Juan, and 800 m from El Morro. Enjoy a complimentary welcome drink, daily Rose Wine, and views from our rooftop bar and infinity pool.

censusName: Qoya Hotel Curitiba Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Qoya Hotel Curitiba, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A vibrant stay in Curitiba
primaryDescription: We’re surrounded by shops and restaurants, with Arena da Baixada Stadium, Shopping Curitiba, and Shopping Crystal within a 15-minute walk. Pátio Batel Mall and 24 Hours Street are less than 2 km, and the Contemporary Art Museum and Jardin Botânico de Curitiba are 6 km away. Enjoy our restaurant and bar, indoor pool, exercise room, and third floor patio.

censusName: Qoya Hotel Sao Paulo, Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Qoya Hotel Sao Paulo, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Walk to restaurants, shops, and museums
primaryDescription: We’re located in the Paulista Avenue region. Patio Paulista Mall, Casa das Rosas Museum, Centro Itaú Cultural, and several restaurants are within a half kilometer. São Paulo Museum of Art (MASP) and Trianon Park are two km away. We’re nine km from Congonhas-São Paulo Airport CGH. We offer an outdoor rooftop pool, restaurants, and meeting rooms.

censusName: Royal Palm Galapagos Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Royal Palm Galapagos, Curio Collection Hotel by Hilton
headline: Unique oasis in the heart of Santa Cruz Island
primaryDescription: In the Miconia Highland Forests, we’re ideally set in the Galapagos, a UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site. Our location features natural lava tunnels, giant tortoise sightseeing, an infinity pool, firepits, yoga forest, and stargazing through telescopes. Enjoy unique tours surrounded by endangered species and scenic landscapes.

censusName: Salvio Parque 93 Bogota Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Salvio Parque 93 Bogota, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: An elevated experience in Bogota
primaryDescription: Overlooking Park 93, our hotel stands out with organically inspired, distinctive architecture. Destination dining, entertainment, businesses, and embassies are minutes away. We offer on-site dining with a wide variety of global flavors, and meeting space with advanced A/V equipment. Enjoy our wellness programs including yoga in the park, massage, and a fitness center.

censusName: SORO Montevideo Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: SORO Montevideo, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Explore charming Pocitos and the Ramblas
primaryDescription: Find our hotel within streets of Pocitos Beach, the coastline Rambla, and eclectic neighborhood restaurants. Within one kilometer, reach the Punta Carretas district and Villa Biarritz — a market full of local vendors. Perks include our rooftop whirlpool, indoor-outdoor dining, and 24-hour fitness center.

censusName: Suryaa Hotel Pinhais, Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Suryaa Hotel Pinhais, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A prime location in Pinhais
primaryDescription: We are just 500 meters from the golf courses at Alphaville Graciosa Clube. Afonso Pena Airport CWB is 30 minutes from us while Planta Folloni Park, Opera de Arame, Newton Freire Maia Park, the Municipal Forest of Pinhais Our Lady of Good Hope, and the Botanical Garden of Curitiba, are all within 15 km. Enjoy our indoor pool, fitness center, restaurant, and bar.

censusName: The Fives Downtown Hotel & Residences Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: The Fives Downtown Hotel & Residences, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A luxurious stay by Playa Del Carmen
primaryDescription: Our hotel is two blocks from white sand beaches and just close enough to the excitement of Playa Del Carmen's famous Fifth Avenue. Spend a relaxed afternoon in our rooftop infinity pool, featuring a panoramic ocean view, cabanas, and sun loungers. The ferry to Cozumel is half a kilometer away.

censusName: Curio Collection by Hilton Mangrove Beach Corendon Curacao All-Inclusive Resort
directoryName: The Rif at Mangrove Beach Corendon Curacao All-Inclusive, Curio by Hilton
headline: An all-inclusive escape in Curacao
primaryDescription: Just two kilometers from Willemstad, our beachfront all-inclusive resort looks out over the sparkling Caribbean Sea and lush mangrove forests. Local museums, UNESCO World Heritage sites, and shopping are within a 15-minute drive. We have onsite restaurants, an outdoor pool, and event space.

censusName: Mahogany Bay Resort & Beach Club Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Tulsa Club Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: A chic retreat in the Deco District
primaryDescription: Our 1927 building in historic downtown Tulsa features Art Deco design by world-renowned architect Bruce Goff. We’re within walking distance of restaurants and bars, and The Gathering Place park is two miles away. Perks include our indoor-outdoor event space for up to 400 guests, on-site dining, and a rooftop terrace.

headline: A historic downtown stay, moments from Zócalo
primaryDescription: Our boutique hotel is in the historic center, and dates to 1924.  The Metropolitan Cathedral and the National Art Museum are both within a 15-minute walk of us. Discover our art gallery, rooftop pool and terrace, hanging garden, mini-cinema, library, and vinyl record collection. Our Experience Curators are on hand to personalize your itinerary.

censusName: Qoya Hotel Sao Paulo Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: V Hotel Dubai, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Sky-high delights above Dubai Water Canal
primaryDescription: Our hotel overlooks the Dubai Water Canal and is designed to reflect the spirit of the city. We’re home to Dubai's premier stage show, La Perle by Franco Dragone, and eight kilometers from Downtown. Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are 10 minutes away, and there are local beaches within 10 km. Enjoy our on-site lounges, restaurants, and nightclubs.

censusName: Curio Collection by Hilton Villa Mercedes Merida
directoryName: Villa Mercedes Merida, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: Elegant rooms and Colonial architecture
primaryDescription: We're in the hotel zone, across from the CIC. The US Consulate General and Paseo de Montejo are five minutes' walk, and downtown Merida is five kilometers away. Count on all-day dining, nighttime entertainment in our lobby bar, and 24-hour room service. We offer seven conference rooms, 24-hour fitness and business centers, a garden, and outdoor pool.

censusName: Zemi Miches All-Inclusive Resort Curio Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Zemi Miches Punta Cana All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton
headline: All-inclusive indulgence in Miches
primaryDescription: Enjoy oceanfront views at our all-inclusive resort overlooking the clear waters of Playa Esmeralda. We’re located 90 minutes’ drive from Punta Cana International Airport, on an exclusive beach near Redonda Mountain. Our resort features over 10 restaurants and bars, four pools, and daily entertainment. Club Azure and bungalow guests have access to additional dining options and a rooftop pool. We also offer a full-service spa and 10,000 sq. ft. of event space.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Bogota Salitre AR
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Bogota Salitre AR
headline: Spa days in the Teusaquillo-Salitre district
primaryDescription: In the Teusaquillo-Salitre district of Bogotá, our hotel is five minutes from Gran Estación mall and a 13-minute drive from El Dorado Airport. We're four kilometers from Bogotá Botanical Gardens, and Mount Monserrate is eight kilometers from us. Enjoy our full-service spa, modified shuttle service, 24-hour fitness center, and a warm welcome cookie on arrival.

headline: Minutes from shopping and attractions
primaryDescription: In Microcentro, find us near companies and attractions. Shopping at Galerias Pacífico and the Plaza San Martín are each a five-minute drive from the hotel. The Obelisco, Plaza de Mayo, and the Puerto Madero Waterfront Area are under two kilometers away. Enjoy our on-site restaurants, fitness center, event rooms, and an indoor pool and sauna.

headline: Close to attractions and nature
primaryDescription: In picturesque Serra Gaúcha, we’re close to the Space Adventure Canela and the Canela Ferris Wheel. The Catedral de Pedra is two km away. The town of Gramado is within six km, while Caracol Park is seven km from our door. Our on-site restaurant, and fitness center complete your stay.

headline: Commercial leisure near central Celaya
primaryDescription: Find us on Boulevard Adolfo Lopez Mateos, in one of Celaya's commercial districts and steps from the main commercial area. We're less than three kilometers from the city center's Alameda Park and Temple of Carmen. Galerías Celaya is five minutes away. We offer a convention center for up to 800 people and a heated outdoor pool. A complimentary cookie starts your stay.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Foz do Iguacu Brazil
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Foz do Iguacu Brazil
headline: Leisure near a waterpark and the city center
primaryDescription: Located on the main avenue of the city's tourist corridor next to Catuaí Shopping. Our hotel is a short drive from Foz do Iguaçu International Airport and the city center. Enjoy our indoor and outdoor pools, tennis court, soccer field, and spa. The famous Iguazu Falls are 25 minutes away.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico
headline: Historic beauty in every direction
primaryDescription: Find us in the historic city center, within three blocks of attractions, including Guadalajara Cathedral, the Degollado Theater, and museums. We offer a top-floor restaurant and bar overlooking the city, and several of our rooms and suites feature an outdoor terrace. Enjoy our fitness center and a warm DoubleTree Cookie when you arrive.

headline: Shopping and views near Las Peñas
primaryDescription: We’re located in the north-central area of Guayaquil, directly across from the iconic Malecón 2000 boardwalk. We’re two blocks from Las Peñas, El Museo Del Cacao, and the Anthropological and Contemporary Art Museum, offering easy access to shopping and sightseeing. Enjoy stunning views of the Rio Guayas from our rooftop bar and our outdoor infinity pool.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Bogota - Parque 93
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Bogotá - Parque 93
headline: Your base for Parque 93 and Zona Rosa
primaryDescription: We’re within blocks of Parque 93, and Zona Rosa’s shops and nightlife are a 10-minute drive away. The Gold Museum and Mount Monserrate are less than 13 km away. We have multilingual staff, a 24-hour shop, mountain views from our roof terrace, and live music in the bar. Enjoy our indoor pool, steam room, and massage services.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Cariari San Jose
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Cariari San Jose - Costa Rica
headline: Easy access to the National Convention Center
primaryDescription: We're by Highway 1, about one kilometer from San José's National Convention Center. We offer a free shuttle to and from Juan Santamaría International Airport seven kilometers away. Our hotel features a heated outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, and free WiFi. Cariari Country Club and golf course are next door. Visit our bars, cafe, and restaurant.

headline: Soothing stays in historic Iquitos
primaryDescription: Overlooking Plaza de Armas de Iquitos, our hotel sits at the historic heart of Iquitos, steps from St. John the Baptist Cathedral. We're two blocks from the portside, linked to the Amazon River, and less than three kilometers from the airport. Enjoy a luxurious outdoor pool and waterfall, massage therapy, and a warm welcome cookie upon arrival.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Mexico City Santa Fe
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel México City Santa Fe
headline: Relax next door to Expo Santa Fe
primaryDescription: Our hotel, connected to Hilton Garden Inn Mexico City Santa Fe, is in the Corporate District, one minute from Expo Santa Fe. Multinational corporations such as Chrysler and Microsoft are within a four-minute drive. Santa Fe City Mall and Parque la Mexicana are two kilometers away. Enjoy our heated pool, fitness center, and restaurant.

headline: Between Querétaro City and Corregidora Stadium
primaryDescription: Find us one block from Corregidora Stadium. The Querétaro Congress Center and historic Santiago de Querétaro are 10 minutes away, and we’re 50 minutes from the Peña de Bernal monolith. We have an indoor pool. Every stay begins with a warm DoubleTree cookie.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Juan Puerto Rico
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Juan
headline: Condado nightlife on your doorstep
primaryDescription: Just moments from the beach and Condado’s vibrant scene, our hotel offers easy access to LMM Airport -just three miles away with easy highway access. Enjoy 24/7 pool access, a Beach Club shuttle, the relaxing Cloud Spa, and a lush tropical courtyard. Explore the buzz of Calle Loíza, savour on-site dining, and unwind in modern rooms featuring complimentary WiFi and 65” TVs.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Santiago - Vitacura
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Santiago - Vitacura
headline: Downtown Santiago within easy reach
primaryDescription: Our hotel is just one block away from the Costanera Center and two kilometers from Parque Metropolitano de Santiago. Downtown Santiago, home to La Moneda Palace, Plaza de Armas, and the National Museum of Fine Arts, is under nine kilometers away. Enjoy stunning views of the Andes Mountains and a warm DoubleTree cookie on arrival.

headline: A beachside stay near central Veracruz
primaryDescription: Find us across the street from Regatas Beach, 10 minutes from the center of Veracruz. We're less than two kilometers from Acuario de Veracruz, the largest aquarium in Latin America, and 10 km from the historic fort San Juan de Ulua. Enjoy a warm DoubleTree cookie on arrival, a fitness center, and outdoor pool.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Lima San Isidro
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Lima San Isidro
headline: Stay comfortable and close to it all in Lima
primaryDescription: Find us in the financial district, San Isidro, within a half kilometer of shopping, dining and Bosque El Olivar. Jorge Chavez International Airport is 14 km from us, and sights like the Historic Center of Lima and Larcomar are less than six km away. Enjoy our signature restaurant, outdoor rooftop pool, solarium, and fitness center.

headline: A quick trip to Villa Fontana excitement
primaryDescription: We're in the Villa Fontana area in southern Managua, three kilometers from the Galerias Santo Domingo Mall. You can park your car here for free, and a range of restaurants are within walking distance. Enjoy our fitness center and take in the mountain and lake views from our outdoor pool.

headline: A beachfront haven in Mazatlán’s Golden Zone
primaryDescription: In the heart of Mazatlán’s vibrant Golden Zone, discover fantastic dining, shopping, and entertainment opportunities within minutes. Our uniquely modern beachfront hotel has direct beach access, four swimming pools, elevated dining experiences, and innovative gathering venues. Warm, authentic service completes your stay.

headline: Scenic stay overlooking Guaíba River
primaryDescription: Find us on the banks of the river in the Praia de Belas neighborhood. We offer the ideal location next to a major shopping center and corporate offices. All the action of downtown is just four kilometers away. Enjoy our fitness center, views of the river from our infinity pool, and exquisite dining in our restaurant.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Punta Cana Downtown
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Punta Cana Downtown
headline: Downtown stay near beaches
primaryDescription: Our downtown hotel is near Plaza San Juan Shopping Center, and within five minutes of Coco Bongo and Caribbean Lake Park. Beaches including Playa Bibijagua and Playa Bavaro are less than 20 minutes away. Punta Cana International Airport is a 12-minute drive. Enjoy our outdoor pool, event space, and on-site dining.

headline: Great views of Santiago
primaryDescription: Just off President Kennedy Avenue, our hotel is less than four km. from Costanera Center and Bicentennial Park. We are surrounded by several restaurants, shops, and businesses. The Santiago city center and Arturo Merino Benitez Airport are about 20 minutes away. Our 17th floor restaurant features panoramic views of the city and mountains.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Sao Paulo Itaim
directoryName: DoubleTree by Hilton Sao Paulo Itaim
headline: Museums and the airport in close reach
primaryDescription: Our hotel is surrounded by popular restaurants and bars in São Paulo's Itaim Bibi neighborhood. We're five kilometers from Ibirapuera Park, home to numerous museums, the Oscar Niemeyer Auditorium, and a planetarium. It's a nine-kilometer drive to Congonhas-São Paulo Airport. Relax by our outdoor pool.

headline: Corporate convenience in Toluca
primaryDescription: Our hotel is in Toluca's industrial zone, within two kilometers of General Motors and Pfizer. We're 10 minutes from downtown, with a free shuttle to Toluca International Airport (TLC). Enjoy a warm chocolate chip cookie when you arrive, and a choice of all-day dining options. Our 17,000 square feet of event space includes 15 ballrooms.

headline: An elegant welcome to Trujillo
primaryDescription: Our hotel is seven kilometers from the city center, just a few minutes from a golf course, shops, restaurants, and parks. We’re 10 minutes from the beach and 20 minutes from the airport. Unwind after a full day at our fourth-floor outdoor swimming pool, fitness center, or spa. We also offer 2,700 sq. ft. of event space for meetings and special events.

censusName: DoubleTree by Hilton Lima Miraflores El Pardo
directoryName: El Pardo Lima - A DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel
headline: Peruvian art and Pacific views in Miraflores
primaryDescription: Our hotel is a 10-minute walk from the ocean and Miraflores attractions like Kennedy Park, Larcomar, and Huaca Pucllana, with the San Isidro business district just a short drive away. Unwind in our gym or relax by the heated pool with stunning city views. Savor cocktails on our terrace, indulge in exceptional Italian dining, and enjoy a warm chocolate chip cookie upon arrival.

censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort
directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort
headline: Escape to Eagle Beach
primaryDescription: With views of the Caribbean, we’re between Eagle Beach and Palm Beach, 15 minutes from AUA Airport. Access the beach via our private tunnel and enjoy our spacious two-room suites, pools, cabanas, daily activities, bars, and restaurants. We offer a kids’ club, free made-to-order breakfast, and specialty cocktails during our daily evening reception.

censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Bogota Rosales
directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Bogotá Rosales
headline: Steps from shopping in La Zona G
primaryDescription: Our hotel is in the heart of Bogotá’s financial and commercial district. Shops and eateries are within walking distance, and attractions such as Park 93, Bogotá Botanical Garden, and the Gold Museum are within four miles. Enjoy free made-to-order breakfast and our complimentary evening reception.

censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Dorado Del Mar Beach Resort
directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Dorado del Mar Beach Resort
headline: Beachfront leisure on Puerto Rico's coast
primaryDescription: Our secluded beachfront resort is on Puerto Rico's northern coast, overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. We’re two miles from Manuel Morales Beach, and 21 miles from San Juan. Relax in our lagoon-style pool, and enjoy pickleball, bowling, a driving range, or the casino across the street. Join us for free breakfast and complimentary evening receptions.

censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Juan Hotel & Casino
directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Juan Hotel & Casino
headline: Relaxing, open space near Isla Verde Beach
primaryDescription: Isla Verde Beach is two blocks away, and we've got a reserved area with chairs and umbrellas. Relax right here in our resort-style pool, featuring a waterfall and foliage. The airport is about five minutes away. Enjoy free cooked-to-order breakfast, and have a drink at our complimentary Evening Reception.

censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Santo Domingo
directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Santo Domingo
headline: Stay in Santo Domingo's tallest building
primaryDescription: Our hotel is the tallest building in Santo Domingo, rising 27 stories above the heart of the business district in Naco. You'll find a number of dining options within a five-minute walk. The Juan Pablo Duarte Olympic Center and Sambil Santo Domingo shopping mall are both within four kilometers.

headline: Comfort and convenience in Aguascalientes
primaryDescription: Located on Av. José María Chávez, we’re about three kilometers from the city’s historic center. It’s a 10-minute drive to concert venues, theaters, and museums. Manufacturers and corporate offices, including Nissan, Inegi, and Grupo Modelo, are 20 minutes away. Plan an executive meeting or event in our 2,800 sq. ft. event space.

headline: Beach life near local history
primaryDescription: Wake up to South Pacific views, just minutes from Playa Paraíso beach. Nearby, you’ll find the shops of Arturo Pratt promenade, the historical architecture of the Museo Regional de Antofagasta, and sports at Estadio Regional. For some culture, visit the Catedral de Antofagasta and the Municipal Theater, both close by. Enjoy hot breakfast and WiFi on us.

headline: A modern base in a beautiful historic setting
primaryDescription: We’re located near Arequipa’s Main Square where you can see the Cathedral, La Compañia and Nuestra Señora De La Merced Church. Here at the hotel, kick back in the heated outdoor whirlpool, in the sunlit colonial courtyards, or at our restaurant and bar, which is carved from volcanic stone. Breakfast and WiFi are free.

headline: Beautiful nature meets family fun
primaryDescription: You’ll be bedding down in a natural area, boasting waterside and mountain views. Eat your way through a crop of Bariloche city restaurants, steps from the door, and explore the downtown area’s ample shopping. Make the most of water sports and family days at Nahuel Huapi Lake, or head inland to Catedral Alta Patagonia ski center. WiFi and breakfast are on us.

headline: City leisure at the ‘Golden Gate to Colombia’
primaryDescription: We’re just five minutes from the heart of Barranquilla and walking distance from the city’s medical center. You’ll be close to the business district, and steps from shopping and nightlife. It’s 10 minutes to both Atlantic and North Universities. Fill up on free hot breakfast before a day at Puerto Colombia's beaches, half an hour away. WiFi’s on us.

censusName: Hampton by Hilton Santiago Las Condes
headline: Centrally located to Bialystok culture, near parks
primaryDescription: Find us downtown off Lipowa Street, a five-minute walk from St. Roch’s Church and The Podlasie Opera and Philharmonic. Kosciuszko Market Square, Branicki Palace, Planty Park, and Galeria Jurowiecka are within one kilometer. We offer sunlit meeting space and catering services. Enjoy our bar, 24-hour fitness center, free hot breakfast, and free WiFi.

headline: Experience the charm and culture of Bogota
primaryDescription: Find us in the heart of the Usaquén neighborhood. Spend an afternoon at Baw Thai Spa or see a movie at Cinema Paraíso, just eight minutes away. Explore the shops at Usaquén Park and Hacienda Santa Bárbara Mall, located seven minutes from our doorstep. We're 40 minutes from El Dorado International Airport. primaryDescription: We're 11 minutes from El Dorado International Airport, just off Avenida Calle 26 – we'll pick you up in our free airport shuttle. Visit the Museum of Modern Art and the Colombian National Museum in downtown Bogota, just 20 minutes away. Enjoy free WiFi and free hot breakfast.

primaryDescription: You’ll be mere steps from Header Stage II Shopping Center and across the street from San Rio Park and Garden. History lovers will be less than two miles from the Cathedral of the Holy Family, and just six miles from the heritage town of Girón. A short drive brings you to all 19 acres of the Eloy Valenzuela botanical garden. WiFi and breakfast are on us.

headline: Right near the Rio Cali
primaryDescription: We're located in the Santa Teresita neighborhood overlooking the Rio Cali, moments from the lively restaurants and nightlife of the El Peñon district. Enjoy easy access to both hilltop Iglesia de San Antonio and the Zoologico de Cali, less than one mile away. Daily free hot breakfast and WiFi are on us.

primaryDescription: Enjoy our rooftop pool, fitness center, and free breakfast to help you start your day. We're located three kilometers from the beach, with the vibrant city center close by, offering the perfect blend of urban convenience and seaside relaxation. Whether you're looking to unwind or explore, our hotel is your ideal base.

primaryDescription: We’re in the Bocagrande district, a 15-minute drive from Rafael Núñez International Airport and walking distance from the beach and restaurants. Cartagena Convention Center and the walled city are both a 10-minute drive away. Enjoy our rooftop pool, fitness center, and free WiFi and hot breakfast.

primaryDescription: We're just minutes from downtown Cúcuta and industrial parks. At Ventura Plaza half a mile north, you'll find plenty of dining, shopping, and entertainment. We're also within walking distance of numerous local restaurants and Simon Bolívar University. Start each day with free hot breakfast. We offer free WiFi in every room.

primaryDescription: In central Cusco, our hotel is within a ten-minute drive of Plaza de Armas and less than three kilometers from the Sacsayhuaman archaeological complex. Qorikancha and Santo Domingo Convent are only 500 meters away. Enjoy free, hot breakfast and free parking. We also offer a hot tub and a meeting room for up to 60 people.

primaryDescription: We’re in the center of David’s commercial district, a short drive from the Pan-American Highway and five kilometers from the Enrique Malek Airport. Boquete is a 45-minute drive away for hiking, specialty coffee, golf, and fine dining. We offer an airport shuttle and meeting space for up to 30 guests. Enjoy daily free hot breakfast and WiFi on us.

Chill out at our tropical garden pool featuring Ms. Piper’s al fresco restaurant and lounge.

primaryDescription: Our pet friendly hotel, located at Solarium Condominium, is surrounded by shops and dining. The beautiful beaches of Del Coco Beach, Poor Calzon Beach and Playa Panama are all less than 30 kilometers away. Explore trails and waterfalls like Catarata La Uvita and Catarata Rincón del Brujo, 20 kilometers from us. We offer free airport shuttle and breakfast each morning.

Try some city restaurants while you’re there, or head out to Parque Shopping Maia to curb retail cravings. Start each day with free hot breakfast. WiFi's on us.

primaryDescription: We're in Medellín's El Poblado district, one mile from Zona Rosa's restaurants and nightlife. Enjoy free hot breakfast with a view from our 14th floor sky lobby and 15th floor terrace. Stay connected with free WiFi.

Fuel up on our hot breakfast before a dip in the pool. Enjoy views of Calcagno Lake from our large deck area. WiFi and parking are on us.

headline: Near shopping and dining in Providencia
primaryDescription: Nestled in the heart of Providencia in Santiago de Chile, our hotel offers a unique blend of sophistication and comfort. Surrounded by trendy and chic décor, our rooms allow you to relax and recharge after a long day of exploring the city’s offerings. We provide culinary delights onsite and are within walking distance of the shops at the Costanera Center.

directoryName: ROK Hotel Kingston, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
headline: In the middle of Jamaica’s hub
primaryDescription: Located in the downtown art district, our hotel overlooks the Kingston Waterfront and Harbor. The National Gallery of Jamaica is across the street, and the Jamaica Conference Center is two blocks from our door. Norman Manley International Airport is 16 km away. We have an outdoor pool and bar and a fitness center.

censusName: The Yucatan Playa del Carmen Tapestry Collection by Hilton
directoryName: The Yucatan Playa del Carmen, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
headline: Adults-only hotel along famed Fifth Avenue
primaryDescription: A sophisticated retreat in the heart of the Riviera Maya. Enjoy an exclusive experience with elegant design, luxury rooms, and the best location, just steps from vibrant 5th Avenue. Unwind in our spectacular pool and start your mornings with a delicious à la carte breakfast at El Mural.

censusName: Yoo2 Rio De Janeiro Tapestry Collection by Hilton
directoryName: Yoo2 Rio de Janeiro, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
headline: Views of Sugar Loaf Mountain in Botafogo
primaryDescription: In the popular Botafogo neighborhood, our hotel offers spectacular views of Sugar Loaf Mountain and Corcovado (Christ the Redeemer). Reach the shops, bars, artisans, and restaurants of Arnaldo Quintela Street in an eight-minute drive. Botafogo Beach is just minutes away. Enjoy our rooftop bar or locally-inspired cuisine in our restaurant.

headline: Steps from restaurants and entertainment
primaryDescription: In central Ankeny, restaurants, bowling, theaters, and the FFA Enrichment Center are less than a half mile from our hotel. The DMACC Ankeny Campus is under a mile away while the John Deere Des Moines Works and Prairie Ridge Sports Complex are within three miles. Des Moines International Airport is a 30-minute drive. Enjoy our indoor pool and fitness center.

headline: Close to shopping and universities
primaryDescription: We’re less than a kilometer from Bochalema Plaza Shopping Mall and surrounded by universities. Unicentro Cali Shopping Mall is seven kilometers away. Chorrera Del Indio – Indian Spring is 30 minutes from us. The Cristo Rey Monument and Pueblo Pance Natural Viewpoint can be reached within an hour. Enjoy our on-site fitness center and business center.

headline: Centrally located close to attractions
primaryDescription: In downtown Chapecó and near SC‑283, we’re 10 kilometers from Chapecó Airport (XAP).  Arena Condá Stadium, Coronel Bertaso Square, and Santo Antônio Cathedral are within two km. The Uruguay River Valley is 24 km away, offering scenic trails and outdoor activities. Enjoy free breakfast, Wi‑Fi, and a lobby lounge with a 24-hour convenience store.

headline: City access near shopping and nature
primaryDescription: Located in the City Center, we’re within five minutes of the bus station, Museum Claudio Arrau, and St. Charles Borromeo Cathedral. Mall Arauco Chillán is one kilometer away. Quilmo Cave, General Bernardo O Higgins Airport, Sunpark Chillán, and Mirador de Boyen are less than 20 minutes from us. Enjoy on-site dining and our fitness center.

headline: Near shopping and local restaurants
primaryDescription: We're near Punto Novel Shopping Center, Ruta Huasteca Expediciones, and within minutes of local restaurants. Tantocob Park is 11 kilometers from us and Tamuín National Airport is 43 minutes away. Guests enjoy an indoor pool, a 24‑hour fitness center, and a gaming area for a relaxed, well‑rounded stay.

headline: Five minutes from city center
primaryDescription: Located next to Críciuma Shopping mall, we are five minutes from Morro do Céu Municipal Natural Park. The city center is 10 minutes away. A great base to explore the Serra do Rio do Rastro Mountains range, our hotel is 70 kilometers from stunning views, trails, and activities. Enjoy free breakfast, WiFi, and a game area in our lobby with 24-hour snack shop.

censusName: Tru by Hilton Palmerola Airport Comayaua
headline: Airport access with pet-friendly rooms
primaryDescription: Our hotel is located directly in front of Palmerola International Airport, and offers an airport shuttle service. Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception, Comayagua Archaeological Museum, and El Chircal Archaeological Site are all within 20 minutes. Enjoy our pet-friendly rooms, complimentary parking, outdoor pool, and fitness center.

censusName: Tru by Hilton Mexico City Airport
directoryName: Tru by Hilton Mexico City Airport
headline: Comfort near MEX Airport and stadium
primaryDescription: We are ideally located near Mexico City attractions and only three kilometers from Benito Juarez International Airport. The GNP Seguros Stadium and the Palacio de los Deportes are each less than a 15-minute drive. Several shopping centers, businesses, and restaurants are nearby. Our complimentary breakfast and fitness center complete your stay.

headline: Your oasis in Fundidora
primaryDescription: Located in the Fundidora Area, we’re across from Arena Monterrey, three kilometers from the city center and 20 minutes from the airport. Cintermex and Fundidora Park are only a five-minute walk away. Breakfast and WiFi are included in your stay as well as access to our outdoor pool and fitness center.

headline: Close to shopping and art
primaryDescription: We’re located just four kilometers from shopping and dining at the Angelópolis Lifestyle Center. The International Museum of the Baroque is three minutes away and the Metropolitan Auditorium is a nine-minute drive. Puebla International Airport is half an hour away. We offer a playground area, 24-hour fitness center, and complimentary parking.

headline: Cliffside paradise in Los Cabos
primaryDescription: Unparalleled relaxation and renewal await where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, on the southern tip of Mexico’s Baja California Peninsula. Enter paradise through the private Dos Mares tunnel for a luxurious stay at Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal, a Forbes Five-Star resort and spa carved into the mountain. Set on 24 acres, our resort is near the pristine Los Cabos beach at the heart of the activity.

headline: Panama City views and Calle Uruguay nightlife
primaryDescription: One block from the Cinta Costera and close to the financial district, our hotel offers luxury in the heart of the city. Surrounded by the nightlife of Calle Uruguay, restaurants and minutes from Casco Viejo, enjoy exclusive services such as our award-winning spa, modern fitness center, locally inspired cuisine and the only personal concierge in Panama certified by Les Clefs d'Or.

headline: Welcome to the Riviera Maya’s Secret Treasure
primaryDescription: Nestled among lush mangroves, Waldorf Astoria Riviera Maya is a sanctuary of luxury, culture, and wellness. With 173 oceanfront rooms and suites, the resort offers transformative experiences inspired by the sacred Yaxché tree. Discover daily curated activities — from sunrise yoga to cultural rituals — and enjoy exclusive access to nearby championship golf courses. Refined accommodations, exceptional dining, and a deep connection to Riviera Maya’s spirit await.
